stories.title: Game Recap — Comeback in the 8th
stories.angle: Cubs 4-3 rally over Pirates. Two solo HRs off Skenes build the lead; O'Hearn 3-run shot off Holmes flips it; Shaw (PH) walk forces Ramirez home to tie in the 8th; Hoerner HBP scores Bregman for the win. No final score in tweet (insights). Two-game win streak.

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
Two solo shots off Skenes. Six strikeouts from Holmes.

Then O'Hearn hit a three-run bomb in the 6th and it was a different game.

Matt Shaw walked in the 8th with the bases loaded. Nico Hoerner got hit. Bregman scored.

Second straight win.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: Holmes — October's No. 1
stories.angle: Holmes 5⅔ IP, 6 K, 2 ER last night. ~1.82 ERA in 6 starts since the deadline. One bad pitch to O'Hearn; everything else was command and results. Bold take: Cubs have a legit ace.

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Clay Holmes: 5⅔ innings, six strikeouts, two earned runs last night.

One O'Hearn three-run shot got him. The rest was command, sequencing, and an ~1.82 ERA in six starts since the deadline.

This is what a No. 1 starter looks like heading into October.
